}}'''Hammar''' was a [[Warder]] and [[Blademaster]] who taught swordsmanship at the [[White Tower]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Hammar}} He was a [[Blademaster]] and by right, owner of a Heron-marked sword.{{ref/book|4|1}}{{ref/book|12|13}}

== Appearance ==
He was said to be solid and shaped like a block of stone, with a gravelly voice to match.

== History ==
It has been stated that he must have respected [[Siuan Sanche]] very highly, due to his decisions that led to his death.

== Activities ==
He required [[Galadedrid Damodred]] and [[Gawyn Trakand]] to fight [[Matrim Cauthon]], still weak from his ordeal with the [[ruby-hilted dagger]], and who was armed solely with a quarterstaff to their swords, to teach them a lesson on combat.{{ref/book|3|24}}

Gawyn killed Hammar, who was trying to free Siuan Sanche shortly after she was stilled and deposed as [[Amyrlin Seat]] by leading an entire host of [[Warders]] to free her.{{ref/book|4|47}}
